name: Advance Air Pollution Monitoring Techniques
description: Monitoring of fine particulate matter using medium-volume speciation samplers, gravimetric analysis, and size-segregated particle collection using a micro-orifice uniform deposit impactor (MOUDI). Includes determination of particle count, geometric mean diameter, personal exposure, and analysis of organic and elemental carbon using thermal-optical reflectance. Water-soluble ions are measured using ion chromatography, and trace elements via inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES). Demonstration of thermal desorption gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (TD-GCMS). Hands-on training on beta attenuation monitor, scanning mobility particle sizer, optical particle sizer, ambient ion monitor (MERGA-R), trace metal monitor (Xact-625i), aethalometer (AE-33), and nephelometer. Data analysis using R, python, and machine learning tools.
